content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Toledo

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you can apply. Review PMI's documented prerequisites—typically a secondary degree plus years of direct project leadership—to verify you meet their baseline. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify which of your roles count toward PMI's experience definition.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. This formal coursework covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Our Toledo-area cohorts run on a flexible schedule; you'll attend synchronous sessions with an expert instructor and retain access to recordings for review.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you've finished the boot camp, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including proof of your education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through documentation requirements and answer questions about the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-prep workshops, practice exams, and one-on-one review sessions to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your proctored PMP exam with PMI's testing partner once you feel confident. Our instructors remain available to clarify complex topics in the days before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, commit to PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or additional certifications. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible workshops and recertification prep to help you stay current and keep your credential active.
